name: SHiP / NA67
full_name: Search for Hidden Particles / CERN NA67 neutrino programme
summary: SHiP is an approved future SPS beam-dump experiment with both hidden-particle searches and a dedicated high-statistics neutrino-scattering programme, including tau neutrinos.
physics_targets: Heavy neutral leptons and other hidden-sector particles
detection_principle: High-intensity protons strike a dense target that produces heavy-flavour hadrons and neutrinos. Muon shielding suppresses backgrounds; a compact scattering detector records neutrino interactions, while a downstream spectrometer searches for decays of feebly interacting particles.

sites.name: CERN SPS ECN3 Beam Dump Facility

status.label: Planned
status.evidence: The 2026 collaboration paper describes the approved future experiment and projected programme.
